notes: εἰς τοὺς πόδας has no expressed possessor, so that article takes the supplied his under rule 20's second arm, while τὴν χεῖρα's article is displaced by αὐτοῦ under rule 20 proper — one verse writing both, which is what shows availability is the test.
ἐξενέγκατε and ἐνδύσατε keep their preverb particles (forth, on) inside their own units under rule 106, no other source token answering to them.
